description: This file defines a VSCode-specific language model handler class that interacts with VSCode's Language Model API, manages model selection, token counting, message streaming, and provides model info. It also includes utility functions for converting tools and fetching available models.

classes.name: VsCodeLmHandler
classes.description: A class extending BaseProvider that manages interaction with VSCode's Language Model API, including model selection, message streaming, token counting, and model info retrieval.

methods.name: convertToVsCodeLmTools
methods.description: Converts OpenAI ChatCompletionTool definitions to VSCode LanguageModelChatTool format, normalizing schemas.

methods.name: initializeClient
methods.description: Initializes the VSCode language model client, creating a new client if not already initialized.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a VSCode language model chat client based on a given selector, returning a default minimal client if no models are available.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Streams a message response from the VSCode language model, handling text and tool call chunks, with token counting and error handling.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Returns model information based on the current client, or fallback info if no client is available.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt using the VSCode language model client.

methods.name: countTokens
methods.description: Counts tokens in Anthropic content blocks, converting them to a string for token counting.

methods.name: internalCountTokens
methods.description: Internal method to count tokens in a string or chat message, with error handling.

methods.name: calculateTotalInputTokens
methods.description: Calculates total tokens for a set of VSCode LM messages.

methods.name: ensureCleanState
methods.description: Cancels and disposes of current request cancellation tokens to reset state.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the VSCode LM client based on options.

methods.name: cleanMessageContent
methods.description: Recursively cleans message content, removing unsupported types.
